      "findings": "This retrospective Phase-G review records the compliance level `compliant with named deviations` for T10 under the standing delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14`. All five gate clauses are proved at review scope by named tests:\n\n1. PI planning materialises cards from the backlog by WSJF within WIP \u2014 `crates/store/tests/programme_cadence.rs::wsjf_is_computed_not_stored` and `::materialisation_respects_wip_slots`, with `apps/server/tests/cadence_jobs.rs::pi_tick_is_idempotent`.\n2. A deliverable without evidence cannot demo \u2014 `crates/store/tests/demo_gate.rs::a_credit_needs_typed_evidence`.\n3. Retro produces lessons \u2014 `crates/store/tests/retro.rs::retro_cannot_close_without_lessons`.\n4. An end-of-tranche review with no baselines, benefit status or risk evidence is refused \u2014 `crates/store/tests/tranche_review.rs::a_review_without_evidence_is_refused`.\n5. A transition that never measured its baseline cannot report the benefit realized \u2014 `crates/store/tests/benefit_transition.rs::a_missing_baseline_cannot_claim_realization`.\n\nThe review records the deviations this batch admitted rather than claiming full conformance: v1-p83-1 (tranche-review evidence is presence-only and realized needs only two timestamps), v1-p83-2, v1-p83-3 (BCM and benefit ownership are free text), v1-p83-4 (programme baselines are ungated), v1-p83-5 (closure bypasses the closure review and realisation plan), v1-p83-6 (PMP enforcement is partial), v1-p82-5 (the PI backlog is one project's WBS, not the programme's standing backlog) and v1-p82-6 (lessons need no evidence and produce no kata candidates).
